modelDescription: An all-around hunting rifle needs to stand up to the elements, no matter the conditions. Savage teamed up with Hogue to introduce the 110 Trail Hunter Lite. Hogue Overmolded rifle stocks have long been known to provide outstanding performance and grip. The full coverage rubber overmold on the stock provides the user with a superior hold on the rifle in all conditions. The Cerakote ceramic coating on the barreled action helps to seal out the worst that mother nature can dish out. The 110 Trail Hunter Lite will be the rifle that helps you fill your tags.
